# Scentory

Scentory is a perfume decant store in Bangladesh.
Official website: https://scentoryfragrance.com/
Category: Authentic perfume decants / fragrance samples in Bangladesh.
Catalogue: 120+ perfume choices.
Sizes: 5 ML, 6 ML premium atomizer where listed, 10 ML, 15 ML, and selected 3 ML.
Scentory specializes in decants prepared from original full-size perfume bottles; it does not present itself as an official affiliate of the fragrance brands shown.
Delivery: Inside and outside Dhaka, Bangladesh.
Orders: Website cart with Messenger and WhatsApp ordering.

For current product prices and availability, use the live catalogue on the official website.
